responsibility: Declares the AVR target’s command-line options and warning switches for GCC’s option-processing machinery. It defines `-mmcu`, code-generation toggles such as short calls, tiny stack, gas ISR prologues, fixed-point behavior, addressing assumptions, floating-type width selections, and AVR-specific warnings, along with the variables and masks these options feed into the backend and driver, so this file is the option table rather than the logic that interprets those settings.
same_name_distinction: This is the AVR option table: unlike avr.cc it does not implement backend behavior, unlike avr.h it does not define target ABI/register macros, and unlike avr.md it does not describe instructions; it declares AVR-specific command-line options, warnings, enums, and the variables/masks that feed the rest of the same-stem backend files.
